scientific_reframing: How do polygenic neurodevelopmental lateralization, early developmental perturbations, and culturally shaped task practice jointly generate the population-level excess of right-hand preference?
handoff_constraints: Separate preference from performance and writing hand.
Treat genetic effects as probabilistic and polygenic.
Keep brain asymmetry as a candidate mediator, not a single location.
Measure cultural pressure and forced switching explicitly.
Do not make individual prediction or clinical claims from a population model.
Keep all future empirical outcomes empty until data are collected.
primary_opportunity: A longitudinal, family-aware, multimodal model of developmental lateralization that tests whether measured culture changes latent motor asymmetry, its observable expression, or both.
